Fluid Requirements Several methods have been devel-
oped for estimating ﬂ uid requirements. Four methods are listed 
in Table 7.2, but it should be noted that these methods only 
estimate ﬂ uid needs. Box 7.4 shows how ﬂ uid needs for an adult 
male would be calculated using each method. Clinical assess-
ment should be used to evaluate whether recommended ﬂ uid
intake is appropriate. Assessment of hydration status includes
evaluation of daily weights and intake and output records; 
physical evaluation of skin, eyes, lips and oral cavity; evalua-
tion of the respiratory rate and lung sounds, and blood pressure
